shadows.usage: restrained depth on elevated panels only

motion.usage: subtle state transitions with reduced-motion support

must: Announcement Hub platform identity uses emerald gradients and white
Organization workspaces use the creator-selected primary and secondary colors throughout the full dashboard
Organization logos render in circular frames
Light, dark, and device-default color modes remain available
All UI remains responsive, keyboard accessible, and honest about unavailable backend data
Preserve role-specific creator, authority, and member experiences
avoid: Fake metrics, reviews, delivery states, or customer counters
Decorative cursor effects or excessive scroll animation
Generic dashboard templates that erase organization branding
Adding parallel components when a project primitive already exists

decisions.decision: Separate platform identity from tenant identity
decisions.reason: Announcement Hub remains recognizably emerald and white while each organization controls its own dashboard palette.

decisions.decision: Use a restrained enterprise interface rather than decorative showcase UI
decisions.reason: The product handles official organizational communication and must prioritize clarity, trust, scope, and delivery status.

decisions.decision: Use an organization identity bar and thumb-zone tab navigation on phones
decisions.reason: Mobile users can identify the active organization and reach their three most frequent role-specific destinations without opening the full administration drawer.

decisions.decision: Use a restrained animated tenant-color canvas behind stable tinted surfaces
decisions.reason: Organization colors remain visible throughout light mode without placing text directly over moving gradients; motion is limited to a decorative layer and respects reduced-motion preferences.
